description: This is a PHP source file for the 'system/framework.php' component of an OpenCart-based e-commerce project. It initializes core components such as autoloading, registry, configuration, error handling, event management, database connection, session, caching, templating, language, URL handling, document management, routing, and response output. The file sets up the execution environment for handling web requests, including error and exception handling, session management, and dispatching actions based on routing configuration.

classes.name: Autoloader
classes.description: Handles autoloading of PHP classes based on registered namespaces.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Serves as a container for storing shared objects/services throughout the application.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Manages configuration settings loaded from files and provides access to config values.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Provides logging functionalities for errors and system messages.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Implements an event-driven system allowing registration and triggering of events.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents executable actions tied to routes or specific points within application flow.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Encapsulates HTTP request data, such as GET, POST, COOKIE, SERVER info.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Responsible for preparing and sending HTTP responses, headers, and output content.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: Database abstraction layer for executing queries and managing database interactions.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Manages user sessions, including starting, validating, and storing session data.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Handles caching mechanisms to improve performance by storing reusable data.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Template engine management for rendering views.

classes.name: Url
classes.description: Utility for URL generation and parsing.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Manages document-level aspects like headers and page metadata.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers class autoload rules for specific namespaces.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores an object or value in the registry for shared access.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a directory path for configuration or language files.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a configuration file or resource.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value or a registered object.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a message to the log file.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers an event, notifying all registered listeners.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a route or action, returning the output or next action.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds an HTTP header to the response.

methods.name: setCompression
methods.description: Sets compression level for HTTP response.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a session, possibly with a specific session ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds data to request or response objects.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs the final response to the browser.
